landmarks: Exact piecewise-linear construction. Fixed crossing windows and amplitude windows; no thresholds chosen using predictions.
recoverability: Counterfactual source raster omits only the labelled first pulse. Contrast >=32, >=4 changed pixels, horizontal and vertical feature extents >=2 source pixels are required for a visible label. Others are ambiguous or unrecoverable, never visible misses.
reporting: Report the complete input and label denominator, raw/aligned endpoints, detector-on-truth error, reconstruction increment and total label error. Abstentions and unresolved source features remain explicit. These are engineering endpoints, not validated clinical QRS or QT measurements.
